mapper.sql: s.id, s.name, s.description, s.address, s.phone, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.status, s.category, s.min_order_amount, s.delivery_fee, s.delivery_time, s.created_at, s.updated_at, (SELECT si.image_url FROM tb_store_image si WHERE si.store_id = s.id ORDER BY si.sort_order, si.id LIMIT 1) AS image_url
mapper.select: /* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.store.dao.findById SQL 명: 매장 기본 조회 */ SELECT FROM tb_store s WHERE s.id = #{storeId}
/* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.store.dao.findAll SQL 명: 모든 매장 조회 */ SELECT FROM tb_store s ORDER BY s.created_at DESC

/* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.store.dao.findByIdWithRating SQL 명: 평점 정보 포함한 매장 조회 */ SELECT , ss.average_rating as averageRating, ss.total_reviews as reviewCount, CASE WHEN s.status = 'OPEN' THEN true ELSE false END as isOpen FROM tb_store s LEFT JOIN tb_store_stats ss ON s.id = ss.store_id WHERE s.id = #{storeId}

/* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.store.dao.findStoreHours SQL 명: 매장 운영시간 조회 */ SELECT h.* FROM tb_store_hours h WHERE h.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY FIELD(h.day_of_week, 'MONDAY', 'TUESDAY', 'WEDNESDAY', 'THURSDAY', 'FRIDAY', 'SATURDAY', 'SUNDAY')
/* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.store.dao.findStoreCategories SQL 명: 매장 카테고리 조회 */ SELECT sc.* FROM tb_store_category sc WHERE sc.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY sc.category_name
SELECT mc.id as categoryId, mc.name as categoryName FROM tb_menu_category mc WHERE mc.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY mc.sort_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_store ( name, description, address, phone, latitude, longitude, status, image_url, category, min_order_amount, delivery_fee, delivery_time, business_number, is_featured, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{description}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{status}, #{imageUrl}, #{category}, #{minOrderAmount}, #{deliveryFee}, #{deliveryTime}, #{businessNumber}, #{isFeatured}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_store SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, address = #{address}, phone = #{phone}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, status = #{status}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, category = #{category}, min_order_amount = #{minOrderAmount}, delivery_fee = #{deliveryFee}, delivery_time = #{deliveryTime}, is_featured = #{isFeatured}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_store s WHERE s.category = #{category} AND s.status = 'OPEN'

SELECT , (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(s.latitude)) * cos(radians(s.longitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(s.latitude)))) AS distance FROM tb_store s WHERE s.status = 'OPEN' HAVING distance <= #{radius} ORDER BY distance ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: /* SQL ID: com.winter.winter_back.domain.store.dao.StoreDao.mergeStoreStats SQL 명: 가게 통계 다시 계산 */ INSERT INTO tb_store_stats (store_id, average_rating, total_reviews, total_orders, updated_at) SELECT #{storeId} , (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2), 0) FROM tb_review r WHERE r.store_id = #{storeId}) , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_review r WHERE r.store_id = #{storeId}) , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_order o WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId} AND o.status = 'DELIVERED') , NOW() ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE average_rating = VALUES(average_rating) , total_reviews = VALUES(total_reviews) , total_orders = VALUES(total_orders) , updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
